text:
Asha: starting helix72k onboarding (int4-hybrid) with aggressive prefill. target ctx=73728, prefill ramp=68k. observed a weird 'backscatter' where short n-grams from ~66k reappear ~20-50 tokens later. pasting quick notes.
Ben: repro command I used:
```
./bringup --model helix72k --quant int4hybrid --context-window 73728 --prefill 68000 --kvcache-mode tiled --rope progressive --prefetch=2
```
Mika: symptom: decoder stable until ~66.1k then emits short 2-4 token fragments that match earlier context. not full repeats, but coherent enough to alter meaning. repro ~10% of runs.
Ori: sanitized log excerpt:
```
[prefill] pos=66104
[kv] fetch shard=14 tile_idx=9223372036854775806 offset=18446744073709551590
[rope] applied_phase=0.99988 phase_expected=1.00012
[decode] emitted: ... 174 289 174 ...
```
Ben: that tile_idx looks like near-int64-max and offset reads like a -106 under signed interpretation -> classic unsigned wrap / cast leak.
Mika: bisect points to commit `tile-prefetch-async` (kernel v1.21) where we added an async prefetch fastpath plus a micro-optimistic tile publish.
Asha: perf tradeoffs: prefetch=2 gives ~14% p99 improvement on long prompts but increases backscatter incidents. prefetch=0 makes it rare.
Ori: hypothesis: optimistic publish returns an aliased/stale tile when eviction/publish race occurs; with progressive RoPE the stale tile's phase doesn't match current pos and the decoder emits coherent fragments (backscatter) instead of random noise.
Ben: mitigation experiment: inserting a cheap 64-bit cookie validation on fetch reduces incidence by ~96% with ~+3% p99 hit. snapshotting every 8k also prevents it (mem cost).
Mika: added a unit test that simulates a wrapped tile_idx (inject 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF6) and asserts fetcher fails fast. will push shortly.
ci-bot: svt/helix-backscatter (pr/cookie-validate) - RUNNING
Asha: quick local logs from the validated fetch run show cookie mismatch rejects the read:
```
[kv] fetch shard=14 tile=7 publish_cookie=0x1a2b3c expected=0x7f8e9d -> reject
[rope] no stale phase applied
[decode] emitted: ... 174 290 301 ... (no backscatter)
```
Ben: added another small patch to the prefetcher: if fetch returns a tile with offset > current_prefill_pos + TILE_SZ treat as stale and abort. cheap bounds check. reduced incidents to virtual-zero in stress runs.
Mika: CI update: svt/helix-backscatter (pr/cookie-validate) - PASS checks=repeat-window-assert
ci-bot: svt/helix-backscatter (pr/cookie-validate) - PASS - checks=repeat-window-assert
Asha: action items:
- Ben: open PR to land cookie-validate + cheap offset bound check. include microbench results.
- Mika: add synthetic negative-offset unit test and add the 4 gold long prompts that triggered backscatter to nightly goldset.
- Ori: run a prefetch backoff sweep (0/1/2) and quantify p99 vs repeat-rate.
- Asha: prepare an onboarding note: recommend prefetch=1 and cookie-validate for initial Dedicated canaries.
Ben: will include telemetry counters (cookie_rejects, offset_aborts) so we can alert if rate >0.2% on long runs.
Mika: small follow-up: if anyone sees a similar pattern but with per-tile rope uniform mode, post here. might be a different root cause.
Asha: thanks all 609 keep updates brief here.
